main.description: Tell whoever wrote a node that it has been answered. Only a member of the node's context may, so that an author cannot be pinged by a stranger, and nobody is told about their own reply.

parent.description: The node that was replied to.

url.description: What a tap opens: a path in the app, or a URL on a configured frontend origin. Anything else is refused.

recipients.description: Devices the message was sent towards.

sent.description: Devices whose push service took it.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such node, or a context the caller may not read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a member of the node's context.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A link that leads out of the app, or a message too long for a push.

errors.name: PushNotConfigured
errors.description: This AppView has no VAPID key (HTTP 503).
